patch_description: Replace the exponentially-weighted moving average with a multi-stage pipeline: (1) estimate local noise via rolling residual standard deviation, (2) apply a Savitzky-Golay style zero-phase polynomial smoothing convolution (which preserves polynomial trends up to order 2 exactly, minimizing lag and tracking error, unlike the moving average that attenuates amplitude and introduces phase delay), and (3) make the half-window locally adaptive in blocks based on local volatility — wide windows in noisy segments to suppress slope changes/false reversals, narrow windows in quiet segments to preserve responsiveness. Output length is kept consistent with the current contract (len(x) - window_size + 1) so external code still works. All stages are convolution-based (O(n)), preserving efficiency_score 1.00.
